description: Real, live-verified finding-ID prefixes for DVWA (http://localhost), from docs/10-implementation-plan-ph1b.md Step 2's 'Full synced-set run' and docs/11-implementation-plan-ph2.md Step 5's first-party XSS/SQLi templates (2026-08-28). The xss-/sqli- prefixes only fire when DVWA_COOKIE is set — without it they hit a 302 login redirect and contribute no findings, which is not itself a false positive. Deliberately NOT listed here: nuclei-waf-detect, a confirmed real false positive (2026-08-28) — the upstream template's 'apachegeneric' matcher is just the regex `(?i)apache`, matched against the whole response including headers, so any server whose Server header literally says Apache (i.e. almost any Apache-fronted target, WAF or not) trips it. Left unlisted on purpose so the FP-rate script keeps surfacing it.
